analysis:
Examined three changes. (1) The GLM wired-limit advice is new and diagnostic only (GLMWiredLimitAdvice.swift, DoctorCommand.swift:82-87 and 107-111). It reads sysctl and Metal limits and prints sysctl and LaunchDaemon guidance. It does not change trust, attestation or authorization, and it is kept out of buildDoctorChecks so `verify` does not fail. The printed LaunchDaemon install commands come from ProviderCore, which is not supplied. They are text for the operator to run, but the root-install content cannot be assessed here. No finding.

(2) Darkbloom.swift:178-229 and StartCommand+Modes.swift:216-217 change the registration weight hash. For models with weightsVerifiedByManagedLoad, a recorded hash in VerifiedWeightHashStore is now reused when file identities match. Previously the hash was computed in full at every startup. This touches T-012, T-027 and A-004. The registration hash is self-reported and the operator is adversarial (ADV-001). Reuse is gated on file identities, and the comment says the managed load re-verifies SHA-256 before serving. The identity fields (size, mtime, inode?), the record file's location, permissions and integrity, and whether the managed load really compares against an independent manifest are all in unsupplied source (VerifiedWeightHashStore, the ModelInfo flag, the load path). If identities are weak, or the record file is operator-writable and the load check is absent or skippable, an operator could keep a registered hash for substituted weights. That would weaken the coordinator's weight-hash gate, which is already fail-open per SEC-007. The fingerprint is still captured before the hash, preserving the safe order. I report no finding because the bypass depends on the unverified contract that the load re-verifies. A reviewer with the VerifiedWeightHashStore and managed-load source should confirm that (a) identities include size, mtime and inode/ctime, (b) the record file is owner-only and atomically written, and (c) a load-time mismatch fails closed. T-012 should also note that registration hashes may now come from a cache record.
